CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: App webview search-and-shop route opens correctly and is not publicly indexed
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: From app context open the shop/search icon and land on the dedicated search-and-shop route; verify navigation back returns to prior app context.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Search-and-shop route is reachable from app context.
Back navigation returns user to expected prior context.
Route is configured with no-index behavior.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Search results page renders product results for valid terms
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Submit multiple valid search terms and confirm dedicated results route, product grid rendering, and stable pagination/loading states.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Search term submission always reaches the search results page.
Product grid renders without blocking errors.
Repeated queries keep page responsive and consistent.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Key filters narrow search results correctly
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Apply and remove color, designer, category, and price filters on results page and observe product list updates.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Filter selections update product results correctly.
Removing filters restores broader result sets.
No filter causes broken or empty-state errors when matching products exist.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Autocomplete returns designer/category suggestions with valid destinations
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Type partial terms for designers and categories and select suggestions to validate navigation to correct DLP/PLP destinations.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Suggestions appear while typing relevant terms.
Selecting a designer/category suggestion opens a valid destination page.
No malformed slug or duplicate path fragment appears in URL.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Configured redirect terms route to curated destinations instead of generic product search
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Search known configured redirect keywords and verify user lands on mapped curated pages instead of generic result listings.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Configured redirect terms consistently navigate to curated destination URLs.
Unconfigured terms continue to standard product search results.
Redirect handoff does not produce blank/intermediate error pages.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Manual/custom PLP terms do not trigger unwanted redirects
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Search terms associated with manual/custom PLP rules and confirm search results remain in standard results flow where redirect exclusion is expected.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Excluded manual/custom PLP terms do not redirect unexpectedly.
Search results are shown normally for excluded terms.
Behavior is consistent across repeated attempts.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Match-slug based internal redirects and FE consumption are consistent
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Test terms expected to produce match-slug behavior and confirm FE redirects correctly when match exists and remains on results when not matched.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Matched terms trigger the intended redirect behavior.
Non-matched terms remain on product results flow.
No redirect loop or partial load occurs.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Search behavior parity is maintained across NAP and MRP
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run core search, filter, autocomplete, and redirect checks on both NAP and MRP acceptance environments.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Core search flow works on both brands.
Known brand-specific datasets do not break shared behavior.
No cross-brand routing anomalies appear.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Back and forward browser/app navigation remains coherent through search journey
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Perform multi-step journey (search entry -> autocomplete/submit -> results -> product/listing -> back/forward) and verify state continuity.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Back navigation returns to expected previous screen/state.
Forward navigation replays route without broken context.
Search state does not reset unexpectedly unless intended.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Vertex-based search does not regress baseline discoverability behavior
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run a short end-to-end journey from query to landing page/product page for several terms and verify outcomes remain relevant and actionable.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Users can discover products or curated pages for representative terms.
Journey completes without major UX regressions.
Failure cases are limited to known documented gaps.
